name: Moped
description: A two- or three-wheeled vehicle whose motor can't propel it faster than 30 mph on a level surface, with a drive system that needs no gear shifting. An electric two-wheeler that isn't an electric bicycle and tops out at 30 mph lands here.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels, and a power drive system that doesn't require the operator to shift gears (Michigan Compiled Laws §257.32b)
Its motor can't propel it faster than 30 mph on a level surface; the definition also caps an engine at 100 cc (Michigan Compiled Laws §257.32b)
Not an electric bicycle: one modified past its class limits, or with a motor over 750 watts, is no longer one (Michigan Compiled Laws §§257.32b, 257.662a)
Riders need an operator's license, or a special restricted moped license available at 15 with no road test
Riders under 19 must wear a crash helmet
No certificate of title needed, but it must carry a manufacturer's identification number on its frame
Ridden as near the right side of the roadway as practicable, no more than two abreast, and not between lanes of traffic
